messages:
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 60% for r2026.03.24 build def456. Post-deploy synth shows embed-eu p99 latency spike to 1.2s and small 429 bump in eu-north-1. No 5xx. Link: https://telemetry/release/r2026.03.24
Nisha: seeing p99 tail, p95 OK. Traces point to quota-check retries and a backlog in quota queue after node churn.
Evan: infra logs show node pool scaling event at 11:05, a few nodes joined and image pre-pull missed. Restart count +4 in eu-north-1.
infra-bot: Noted image-pull timeouts causing hot starts: job=prepull-failure-112
Nisha: Recommend immediate mitigation: pin embed-eu in eu-north to previous variant v2026-03-23 for 15m and run a focused synthetic replay. Command: deployctl pin-route --route embed-eu --region eu-north-1 --version v2026-03-23 --duration 15m --reason "p99 tail + 429s"
ops-bot: Executed pin action pa-334 at 2026-03-24T11:12:03Z. Synthetic replay queued: sr-3344.
Evan: Also bumped quota-worker pool by +2 and re-queued image pre-pull job prepull-334.
release-manager: Created REL-4249 and added a release note: "Temporary regional pin to mitigate embed p99 tail during canary." Link: https://issues/release/REL-4249
ops-bot: Synthetic replay results: p99 down to 420ms, 429s back to baseline. Pin will auto-unwind after 15m.
Nisha: Good. We'll keep the global canary paused at 60% until pin unwinds and stability confirmed. If restarts repeat we will rollback globally.
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 60% by team. Monitoring window extended +20m.
notes: Pinned embed-eu in eu-north to previous variant for 15m due to p99 tail; REL-4249 created; autoscale and prepull retried
